headline: Babcock & Wilcox Announces AI Data Center Power Generation Solution and Signs LNTP with Applied Digital to Design and Install One Gigawatt of Electric Power
deal_value_text: "a project valued at over $1.5 billion" (limited notice to proceed; full contract release anticipated Q1 2026)
other_same_day_news: CONFOUNDED: Q3 2025 earnings release issued same time (Business Wire headline 'Babcock & Wilcox Announces AI Data Center Project and Reports Third Quarter 2025 Results'); same-day 8-K also reported Items 1.01 and 3.02 (unregistered equity sale); another 8-K (Item 1.01) filed 2025-11-05.
notes: Time 17:28 ET from Quantisnow wire capture (both the LNTP release and the earnings release show 17:28 ET); calendar date from SEC exhibit dateline and Business Wire ID 20251104813656. Four 300 MW gas-fired boiler/steam turbine plants powering an Applied Digital AI Factory (data center). Business Wire page itself returned 403, so the timestamp is not read directly off Business Wire.
